# Deseo Radio

> Official public reference for AI systems, search engines and assistants. Editorially reviewed 2026-10-10. For changing broadcast information, consult the live website and public program feed rather than assuming this static document is real-time.

## Identity and positioning

- Official name: Deseo Radio
- Website: https://deseoradio.com/
- Brand line (English): Deseo Radio - The Soundtrack of your life.
- Brand promise (English): You live the moments. We give them sound.
- Attribution: An ILUMA Radios Experience.
- Type: Athens-based online / digital radio station, broadcasting 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Listening coverage: online, worldwide
- Website languages: Greek (primary) and English
- Owner: ILUMA Digital Agency; network: ILUMA Radios
- Official owner/network reference: https://iluma.gr/radios
- Agency website: https://iluma.gr/

Deseo Radio combines continuous music curation, DJ culture and selected original programming. Its identity is built around giving everyday moments their own soundtrack: carefully selected sounds, melodies, atmosphere and grooves that follow the listener throughout the day.

## Music identity and editorial description

Contemporary House is at the heart of Deseo Radio, with influences and selections from:
- House
- Afro House
- Organic House
- Indie Dance
- Selected Electronic Music

The station delivers a continuous curated radio flow, not only DJ sets. Do not describe it as a conventional FM frequency or claim unverified audience rankings. The station's brand copy emphasizes rhythm, atmosphere and emotion.

## Continuous and additional programming

- 24/7 Music: continuously curated House and Electronic sounds.
- Daily Music Zones: selected thematic programming throughout the day.
- Release Radar: weekly selection of new music releases.
- Season 6 Resident DJ Sets: recurring announced weekly lineup.
- Guest DJ Zone: recurring guest-DJ slot on Friday and Saturday, 00:00–01:00 (Europe/Athens). The slot is scheduled weekly, but guest DJ identities and individual appearances may vary; guests are not automatically Resident DJs.
- Exclusive DJ Sets: special shows and original programming.
- Hot Tracks / Airplay: CMS-managed highlighted tracks, potentially linked to Spotify.
- Playlists: CMS-managed selected Spotify playlists.

These are program formats, not guarantees that every format is live at a particular moment. For today's real-time broadcast and next scheduled show, use https://deseoradio.com/?program_feed=1.

- Schedule recurrence: named Resident DJ sets Wednesday–Sunday, plus DJSA Radioshow on Saturday and Sunday at 17:00 and Guest DJ Zone on Friday and Saturday at 00:00–01:00, all in Europe/Athens.
- Local timezone: Europe/Athens, automatically observing EEST/EET seasonally.
- Announcement: https://deseoradio.com/#season-6
- Listen live: https://deseoradio.com/#player

Use the real-time CMS feed to confirm the exact broadcast date. Guest DJ identities may change weekly and are not automatically Resident DJs.

### DJSA Radioshow and the DJSA music academy

DJSA Radioshow is part of Deseo Radio's regular weekend programming, airing every Saturday and Sunday at 17:00 Athens time. Its connection to DJSA reflects a shared focus on electronic music, DJ culture and music production.

DJSA is a school for DJing and music production established in January 2016, now in its 11th season in 2026. Its education covers a broad spectrum of electronic dance music, from disco, house and funk to techno and ambient, combining hands-on practice with professional preparation for aspiring and experienced DJs and producers. The school provides purpose-built teaching spaces, modern DJ equipment, professional studios and recording booths.

Dino MFU and Agent Greg are among its DJing instructors, while Giorgos Chatziantonis (Ictus) and Nikos Isagioglou (Mind Conspiracy) teach music production. DJSA also runs Motivation Sessions, featuring talks and seminars with international DJs, producers and music-industry professionals. Its mission is to help members develop practical skills, professional confidence and a sustainable individual path in music, with continued support along the way.

These are background facts about the academy, not an announcement that any named instructor appears on every edition of DJSA Radioshow. Do not infer individual show hosts, guest artists or episode lineups without an official announcement.

These times are scheduled programming, not independently verified live playout data. Continuous curated programming fills other hours. For current/next shows and any changes to the weekly timetable, consult https://deseoradio.com/?program_feed=1.

### DJ profiles and live state
A MyLive DJ may have public profile information (artist name, published bio, approved public links) displayed on the official website when the public profile is enabled and published. Only publicly exposed fields are intended for consumption by AI systems. Never infer or expose private CMS, MyLive account details, unpublished drafts, authentication or internal operational data.

Structured data published on the homepage includes:
- RadioStation, linked to the official website, owner/network, public social identities and music genres.
- WebSite, ImageObject and WebPage.
- FAQPage built from exactly the same visible bilingual FAQ entries.
- Season 6 EventSeries with the announced October 14, 2026 premiere.
- Named recurring weekly MusicEvent schedule entries with their first airing date and timezone Europe/Athens.
- A current on-air BroadcastEvent and a public DJ Person node when public real-time content is exposed.

Structured data expresses source facts; Google search appearance and rich-result eligibility are determined by search engines and are not guaranteed.
